sections.title: Location and Contact
lines: Practice name: Beacon Optical, powered by Abita Eye Group.
Address: 7328 NW 36 St, #4, Doral, FL 33166.
Email: newpatient@abitaeye.com.
Primary phone: (786) 465-7509.
Alternate phone: (305) 723-1910.

sections.title: Hours
lines: Hours are Monday through Thursday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

sections.title: Providers
lines: Dr. Maria Casas works at Beacon Optical.

sections.title: Services
lines: Beacon Optical offers comprehensive eye exams, refraction for eyeglass prescriptions, contact lens fittings, and insertion training.
The office can also schedule an eye exam with one of its professional optometrists.

sections.title: Age Restrictions
lines: Beacon Optical can see patients as young as 7 years old.

sections.title: Outside Prescriptions
lines: The office accepts outside prescriptions.

sections.title: Glasses Workflow
lines: If the patient already has a prescription from their optometrist, they can bring it in and choose from the frame selection.
If the patient needs a prescription, the office can schedule an eye exam first and then help them browse frames and lenses.

sections.title: Contact Lens Workflow
lines: The office offers contact lens fittings and insertion training.
If the patient is getting their first set of contact lenses, the exam and training take longer than a standard visit.
First-time contact lens visits must be scheduled before 4:00 PM.
Ask whether the patient has worn contact lenses before when the visit is for contacts.

sections.title: Frame Selection
lines: The office carries many major frame brands including Gucci, Balenciaga, Carrera, Carolina Herrera, Nike, Vivid, Ferragamo, Minima, Mont Blanc, Miyagi, Guess, and Swiss Flex.

sections.title: Lens Types and Upgrades
lines: The office offers all types of lenses, including upgrades and treatments.
The office offers a wide range of lenses and lens upgrades.

sections.title: Glasses Turnaround
aliases: when will my glasses be ready
lines: Glasses are usually ready in less than 10 business days.

sections.title: Warranty and Adjustments
lines: Frames include free adjustments and a one-year warranty.

sections.title: Prescription Validity
aliases: how long is my prescription good
lines: A prescription is valid for up to two years.
It is still best to get an eye exam yearly to make sure the lenses are still right for the patient.
